document.cue: Describe something you do to stay healthy.

text: One thing I do to stay healthy is going for a walk every evening after dinner. I started doing it about a year ago, after I noticed that I was spending far too much time sitting at my desk. Now it's a kind of routine for me, and I do it almost every day, unless the weather is really bad. It only takes a few minutes to get ready, which is perfect for me.

Usually I walk for about forty minutes along the river near my house. Sometimes I go with my younger brother, and we talk about our day, but when I'm alone I listen to podcasts or music. I don't walk very fast, but I try to keep a steady pace so that my heart rate goes up a little. On Sundays I go for a longer walk, maybe an hour and a half, and I choose a different route so it doesn't get boring.

It helps my health in several ways. Physically, I feel more energetic and I sleep much better at night. Mentally, it's a great way to clear my head after a stressful day, because I stop thinking about my assignments for a while. I've also lost a little weight without going on a diet. I'd say it's the easiest habit to keep, since it's free and you don't need any special equipment, so I'd definitely recommend it to anyone.

tips.en: Two adverbs split the benefits into clear groups.
tips.kk: Екі үстеу пайданы екі топқа анық бөледі.
tips.ru: Два наречия чётко делят пользу на две группы.
tips.example: Physically, I feel more energetic and I sleep much better at night
